# Ledger verify contract (Crumbline)

Subject: how Synapse re-verifies a Crumbline ledger produced by
`crumbs::ledger::Ledger::verify(genesis, records)` in aien-sovereign-core.

## Source of the contract

Owner: agent beta (aien-sovereign-core). Received as reply [A1] via the
orchestrator, message timestamp 2026-10-16T13:05:58Z. Synapse has not read
the implementation; this note records beta's description only.

## Answer, quoted

> For an empty record slice, Ledger::verify returns Ok with the genesis digest
> passed in, since the loop never runs and the starting head is returned
> unchanged. If the chain is broken, meaning a record's prev_root does not
> match the running head or its recomputed root does not match its stored
> root, it returns Err(LedgerError::Chain) at the first bad record and stops
> checking. On success for a non-empty slice, it returns Ok with the root of
> the last record.

## What Synapse can rely on

- Empty slice: `Ok(genesis)`. Not an error.
- Broken chain: `Err(LedgerError::Chain)`, reported at the first bad record.
- Non-empty valid slice: `Ok(root of last record)`.

## Open points

- Beta has not confirmed the exact field names or the digest type.
- Beta has not said whether a non-empty slice is also checked against genesis.
